$comment: Clip look (plan docs/plan/2026-11-21-clip-music-name-transitions.md, D408/D411; user 2026-11-20: 'need more options ... and a randomise these effects options in settings'). Each reel gets one seeded pick of music mode, transition set and name style from the user's ticks in <data>/settings.json clips.look (Settings > Clips > Clip look). Read by services/clip/clip_look.py and services/studio-ui/user-settings.mjs (same rules). A lock always uses its one choice; randomise off uses the first tick. An empty tick list switches that part off. The last picks live in <data>/clips/look-history.json; a pick never repeats the last historyN of its group while another tick is free. Behind the flag clip-look (on: the user asked for it). FX6 (D429): the ai source makes a track on this PC (data/clip/music-gen.json) only when the ACE-Step runtime folder is set (env UJWALAM_ACESTEP_RUNTIME, else clips.look.music.aiRuntime, picked in Settings > Clips) and holds its Python; stored generated tracks are reused with the tick alone; without it the tick does nothing. Saved sources from before FX6 (no aiOffered) get ai added once, like packOffered.
levelSource: D437 (2026-11-22): levelDb default -16 -> -20 and the music now plays underGameDb (8) under the reel's own game mix, never louder than levelDb. Measured on 11 reels made 2026-11-22: game mix -27 to -38 LUFS where no music played, music at -16 LUFS 11 to 22 LU louder (docs/evidence/2026-11-22-reel-music-level-fades.md). voiceDuckDb: extra lowering while someone speaks (Silero VAD). fadeInSec/fadeOutSec/fadeCurve: the start fade-out and end fade-in (s-curve, 1.5 s; sources in D437).

loudness.$comment: D440 (user 2026-11-22 said yes): every finished reel, montage and long video is raised (or lowered) to music.loudnessLufs integrated (default -14, YouTube's playback level: it turns loud videos down but never quiet ones up). One fixed gain ahead of the existing true-peak limiter (-4 dBFS, 4x oversampled), measured by an audio-only pre-pass of the same mix (passes: the mix as it is, then the gain checked through the limiter and corrected by the measured slope). A mix whose peaks are far above its average can not reach the target under the limiter: the record says how close it got. Not a riding AGC. A failed pre-pass renders as before. music.loudnessLufs null = leave the level as it is. Read by services/clip/clip_loudness.py.
